title: 颠倒台（dinnerbone table）
description: 想要让木头变下界合金块吗？想要让煤炭变黄金吗？那就快来体验“颠倒台”吧！（Want to turn wood into netherite blocks? Want to turn coal into gold? Then come and experience the dinnerbone table right now!）
body: 想要让木头变下界合金块吗？想要让煤炭变黄金吗？那就快来体验“颠倒台”吧！你可以使用它将好的变成不好的，将不好的变成好的。你可能只一个木头，却能放入颠倒台中，转换成下界合金块。颠倒台只需四个原木，四个钻石块和一个红石块即可合成，虽然昂贵，但是非常的值，甚至可能会改变整个世界的贸易。它还有维度颠倒台和时钟颠倒台两个变种，维度颠倒台可以颠倒维度，时钟颠倒台可以颠倒时间，还有更多玩法等待大家探索！我做这个模组的原因就是想让贸易拥有巨大的变化。本人是新手，目前模组也......不怎么样，希望大家能支持我！（Want to turn good items into bad ones? Want to swap the Overworld for the Nether? Then come try the dinnerbone table! You can use it to reverse the value of things—good to bad, and bad to good. You might only have a single piece of wood, but pop it into the dinnerbone table, and it could turn into a netherite block.The dinnerbone table is crafted with 4 logs, 4 diamond blocks and 1 redstone block. It’s pricey, but absolutely worth it—it might even revolutionize the entire world’s trading system.It also has two variants: the dimension dinnerbone table that reverses dimensions, and the clock dinnerbone table that reverses time. There are plenty more ways to play waiting for you to discover!I made this mod because I wanted to bring huge changes to trading. I’m a newbie modder, and right now this mod is... well, not the best. I hope you all can support me!）
